review.summary: The change implements TASK-066B and meets the acceptance criteria that can be checked before merge; the one finding is a low-severity documentation inconsistency. The branch starts from the TASK-066A merge on main, which has not moved since, so no rebase was needed. The reformat commit 16c5911 was not reviewed line by line; instead, in a separate worktree with a fresh frozen-lockfile install, running pnpm format on its parent produced a tree identical to the commit, a second pnpm format on the commit changed nothing, and the commit touches only files under frontend/ (63 files: 60 TypeScript/JavaScript, 2 CSS, 1 JSON), so it is pure formatter output and test files changed only by formatting. The Prettier configuration, ignore file, version and scripts are unchanged. The second commit dc1c897 touches no frontend files; it adds the CI format-check step between dependency installation and lint in the frontend-checks job exactly as specified, adds the frontend-format and frontend-format-check Make targets with the check first in frontend-check, lists both in make help, and updates every document and template named in the task's Documentation section, including the formatting sentence in CONTRIBUTING.md. On the head commit in the clean worktree, make frontend-check (format check, lint, 311 tests and build) passed and the review-record validator passed. The implementation reported byte-identical built CSS, an index.html that differs only in the hashed entry-script name, and 58 remaining lines over 100 characters, all string, template or className literals, comments or a CSS data URL; the developer reported a clean visual check and passing CI frontend checks. No security, dependency or out-of-scope change was found.

findings.summary: The CI pipeline lists in docs/TESTING.md and in two places in AI-FIRST-ENGINEERING-HANDBOOK.md still omit the format check that step 12 of docs/AI-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW.md now lists before Lint.
findings.rationale: The task named only the step 12 pipeline in docs/AI-DEVELOPMENT-WORKFLOW.md, so the implementation followed the specification, but the CI Expectations section of docs/TESTING.md, the handbook's step 12 and its CI/CD Policy describe the same pipeline and now disagree with the workflow document and the CI workflow.
findings.recommendation: With developer approval, add Format check before Lint to these three pipeline lists in this task, or accept the inconsistency and leave them for a later documentation task.
